email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with a mild headache
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 40-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 1 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 03/04/26.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild headache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Novak (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter666@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
